source: Connected GitHub organization inventory, repository documentation, and Daunte's July 31 classification

repositories.name: bpp-workspace
repositories.purpose: The shared operating brain for BPP business context, plans, client work, skills, memory, and source documents.
repositories.client_value: Holds the source knowledge that BPP turns into plans, systems, workflows, and client deliverables.
repositories.next_action: Keep as a core private repository and formalize which records feed BPP HQ.

repositories.name: bpp-tools
repositories.purpose: Runs the current BPP Hub and the new BPP HQ interface, including dashboards, registries, operating pages, and shared navigation.
repositories.client_value: Proves the command-center pattern BPP can adapt for clients after internal security, governance, and migration are complete.
repositories.next_action: Keep as a core repository, move internal content behind sign-in, and separate public tools from private HQ.

repositories.name: bpp-plugins
repositories.purpose: Packages repeatable BPP AI capabilities so workflows can be installed, versioned, tested, and reused.
repositories.client_value: Turns BPP's delivery knowledge into repeatable AI-assisted workflows instead of one-off prompting.
repositories.next_action: Keep as a core repository and migrate proven workspace skills into model-agnostic capability packages.

repositories.name: bpp-free-tools
repositories.purpose: Publishes BPP assessments, calculators, guides, and other public lead-generation tools.
repositories.client_value: Lets prospects experience BPP's diagnostic thinking before a sales conversation and creates a natural path into paid system work.
repositories.next_action: Keep as an important public repository and connect each tool to a measurable lead and follow-up path.

repositories.name: .github
repositories.purpose: Stores the shared rules and templates that should apply across repositories in the BuildwithBPP organization.
repositories.client_value: Creates consistent delivery and security behavior across BPP-built systems, even though clients rarely see it directly.
repositories.next_action: Keep small, document it as governance, and avoid storing business or client content here.

repositories.name: bpp-webflow-site
repositories.purpose: Previously stored Webflow site snapshots, metadata, scripts, and website maintenance workflows.
repositories.client_value: Provides historical website operations knowledge, but it is no longer a dependable backup because the required Webflow plan is unavailable.
repositories.next_action: Place on hold, preserve useful documentation, and decide whether any active website process still depends on it.

repositories.name: ai-workflows
repositories.purpose: Stores structured prompts and repeatable AI workflows, including client-specific proposal and document-processing patterns.
repositories.client_value: Captures working client automation patterns that can become governed capabilities and reusable delivery assets.
repositories.next_action: Separate reusable templates from client-specific material, then decide what graduates into bpp-plugins.

repositories.name: AI-Automation
repositories.purpose: Stores n8n workflow templates and early automation experiments.
repositories.client_value: May contain reusable automation building blocks, but the repository is too lightly documented to treat as active intellectual property today.
repositories.next_action: Inventory useful workflows, move retained assets into the governed capability structure, and then review the repository for archival.

repositories.name: bpp-website-starters
repositories.purpose: An early placeholder for reusable website starter foundations.
repositories.client_value: Could shorten future website delivery if it becomes a maintained starter with clear standards and supported platforms.
repositories.next_action: Define one supported website starter or consolidate the useful pieces into the main delivery toolkit.

repositories.name: ruflo
repositories.purpose: A large upstream multi-agent orchestration fork used for exploration rather than a current BPP production dependency.
repositories.client_value: Provides research exposure to multi-agent patterns, but does not currently represent a supported BPP client capability.
repositories.next_action: Confirm whether any BPP workflow depends on the fork. If none do, treat it as an archive candidate rather than a core repository.

repositories.name: rblawnpros-site
repositories.purpose: A client-specific website repository with limited current documentation.
repositories.client_value: Represents completed or in-progress client delivery rather than BPP's shared operating infrastructure.
repositories.next_action: Confirm the client retention requirement, current deployment dependency, and handoff status before archiving or consolidating.

repositories.name: xtremely-clean-hub
repositories.purpose: Runs the Xtremely Clean operating hub as a client-specific command-center implementation.
repositories.client_value: Provides a real client example of the operating-hub concept and can inform the repeatable command-center delivery method.
repositories.next_action: Keep as a client implementation, document its architecture and outcomes, and complete a dedicated security and reuse review before using it as the product template.
